title: Local entity and relation extraction from rights-cleared Bianjing lantern evidence
research_question: Does ontology-constrained local extraction with an evidence gate improve entity, relation and end-to-end triple F1 over rule-based and unconstrained local extraction?

annotation.design: two independent annotators followed by third-expert adjudication
annotation.span_convention: zero-based Unicode code-point offsets with an exclusive end

evaluation.split_strategy: source-stratified development/test split grouped by evidence locator
primary_metrics: exact entity micro F1 on the frozen test partition
end-to-end relation micro F1 on the frozen test partition
end-to-end triple micro F1 on the frozen test partition
methods: E27 ontology-constrained local Qwen3-8B with evidence gate
evaluation.formal_result_gate: No formal score may be produced until every gold record is adjudicated and frozen.

comparability_note: The Xuan-paper extraction pipeline motivates the task design, but its reported 84.6% F1 concerns entity retrieval and linking rather than a separately reported relation-extraction F1. E27 is therefore evaluated on its own frozen corpus without claiming a direct SOTA comparison.
